correctness.rationale: Every possible unbordered start has a boundary between unequal consecutive letters. Two explicit universal border predicates cover the 1-initial and 0-initial starts; their four cyclic instances yield the four-gap law. The 75 weak-order cells are an exact disjoint partition of all nonnegative gap quadruples, each with an explicit integer rational series; exact polynomial identities verify all four numerators and the unrestricted total. A word/marked-one bijection transfers to indexed words. Current-file direct exhaustions of all weight-four words for n=4..20 and 2401 additional gap configurations independently check boundaries, including periodic and zero-gap cases. No infinite claim rests solely on finite tests.

value.rationale: Binary border correlation is a natural invariant, and the move from three to four one-markers introduces nonlocal opposite-gap obstructions. The theorem provides the exact four-class distribution for every length, a concise structural law, explicit asymptotics and an independently checkable integer rational certificate, not an arbitrary finite cutoff or a textbook substitution.
